purpose: Descriptive source-conditional heterogeneity audit of the frozen full-minus-composition rank-portability contrast without refitting models or pooling non-independent data routes.

primary_estimand.population: paper-attached processed measurements admitted by T195, T203 and T209 registries
primary_estimand.independent_unit: route-specific effect unit: source/laboratory anchor for T195/T197 and an explicitly exposed paper biological unit for T203/T209; effect units are not interchangeable studies
primary_estimand.contrast: full sequence ridge minus composition-only ridge
primary_estimand.summary: route-specific effect-unit size and interval; descriptive summaries only
primary_estimand.pooling: prohibited across T195/T197 duplicate lineage, T203 and T209 because routes have different source access, unit structure and estimands

analysis_rules.t195: retain all three laboratory-anchor fold effects; do not call them independent biological cohorts
analysis_rules.t197: retain as source-availability sensitivity and do not add it to the T195 primary effect count
analysis_rules.t203: retain the paper-cohort paired effect as author-run analysis-only OOD; fixed-alpha permutation remains exploratory
analysis_rules.t209: retain the HA5-reconciled patient-equal paired effect as author-run analysis-only OOD
analysis_rules.t198: report all eight coverage-threshold effects as a secondary batch-level missingness sensitivity; this is not the T200 subject-equal primary estimand and has no confirmatory p-value
analysis_rules.meta_inference: no pooled p-value, no random-effects claim and no universal superiority claim

claim_boundary: T214 can establish descriptive source-dependent heterogeneity and failure-boundary evidence. It cannot establish independent validation, donor-level generalization, mechanism, clinical utility, no-author reproduction, external adoption or scientific submission readiness.
